title: obc-pack config
description: Configuration for the obc-pack map packer (.osm.pbf -> .obcm). Feature styling is an ordered map: style IDs are assigned 1-based in document order (at most 254 styles), and a way is styled by the first (tag_key, value) match in that order. Unknown keys at the root and inside objects are ignored, so tooling metadata (`_meta`, `disabled`) can ride along and any exported file doubles as a CLI config.

features.description: OSM tag_key -> value -> style. Document order is load-bearing: it assigns style IDs and first-match wins. Within a tag_key, the value "*" is a catch-all: an exact value match wins, otherwise a "*" entry styles every other value that key carries (e.g. building -> "*" paints all buildings without listing each OSM type).

lods.description: LOD pyramid, coarsest tier first. Absent, null, or empty means a single coarsest layer.

marker.description: User-position marker; the shape is fixed in firmware, only the color is configurable.

chunk_size.description: Quadtree chunk payload target in bytes. The maximum is the reader's per-feature vertex cap; the minimum guards against chunks so small that features are dropped wholesale. Values outside the range are rejected at pack time. Governs the geometry sections (LODs) only; the nav graph's chunks are pinned to 512 bytes.

merge_fills.description: Dissolve fill polygons that render pixel-identically - same z_index, color, and priority, with no color2 - into one union per LOD. A pure map-size/render-cost optimization with no intended visual change; false (the default) packs byte-identically to before.

merge_lines.description: Stitch same-styled connected line fragments into maximal polylines per LOD. No intended visual change for solid lines; a dashed or cased line's pattern runs continuously across a former join. false (the default) packs byte-identically to before.

min_component_edges.description: Drop disconnected graph components below this many edges; the largest is always kept.

profiles.description: Bike profiles selectable by index; every non-forbidden multiplier is >= 1.0.

routing.description: Nav-graph routing config (OBCM v10 §8): the island-pruning threshold plus the bike profiles baked into the map's profile table. Absent means the four shipped profiles (Road / Gravel / MTB / Touring).

z_index.description: Painter's order; lower is drawn first.

priority.description: Chunk-overflow drop order: 1 is kept longest, 4 dropped first.

min_lod.description: Index of the coarsest LOD tier that includes this feature; it appears in every tier >= min_lod.

line_style.description: Line stroke style: `solid` (the default) or `dashed`. Ignored for polygons.

color2.description: Optional secondary RGB565 color; absent means none.

style.description: One feature style. `id` is never configured - it is assigned from document order.

color.description: RGB565 as a `0x`-prefixed hex string (1-4 digits) or an integer 0..=65535. Pick values on the panel's RGB222 grid (4 levels per channel) so the editor and the glass agree.

line_style.description:
A line's stroke style (OBCM v10 style-record flag bit 2). The config value is `"solid"` (the
default) or `"dashed"`; the renderer draws dashes for `Dashed` lines and ignores it for polygons
(#557 only carries the bit end to end — later sub-issues render it).

max_mpp.description: Meters-per-pixel upper bound for this tier; null means the coarsest tier.

simplify.description: Topology-preserving simplify tolerance in meters; 0 means no simplification.

min_area_px.description: Drop polygons below this many square pixels; 0 means no culling. Ignored on the finest tier.

name.description: Display name shown on the device (UTF-8, at most 12 bytes on the wire).

default.description: Multiplier applied to any highway/surface class not listed below.

highway.description: Per-highway-class multipliers, keyed by canonical class name.

surface.description: Per-surface-class multipliers, keyed by canonical class name.

profile.description: One bike profile: a display name plus per-class edge-weight multipliers. Unlisted classes use `default`.

multiplier.description: One routing edge-weight multiplier: a number >= 1.0 or the string "forbidden". Values below 1.0 are rejected because the great-circle A* heuristic must stay admissible.
